derivation.process: Stationary unit Gaussian AR(1) Z_t; q_t=Z_t^2

temporal_component_scope: Population kernel weights before finite-T demeaning and before seed/interaction terms; not total estimator coverage.

seed_only_empirical_bootstrap_identity.statement: Conditional variance of the empirical bootstrap mean is ((S-1)/S) times sample_covariance(ddof=1)/S.
seed_only_empirical_bootstrap_identity.source: Multinomial seed weights, not a new simulation

limits: The kernel ratio is one identifiable dependence mechanism, not a proven complete causal attribution of MCS inflation.
Standard MCS also uses a common estimated pair scale for observed and centered bootstrap statistics; this feature alone is not an implementation bug.
A bootstrap-t crossed functional modification is a new proposed procedure and needs a fresh fixed validation.
Corrected studentization alone does not establish validity for every dependence regime or high-dimensional finite seed design.
